Doc Holiday's
HOME OUR STORY BEER / DRINKS EVENTS SPECIALS GALLERY TESTIMONIALS CONTACT ADMIN
Entertaining, relaxing, and friendly atmosphere for you and your friends to enjoy
Foley, AL 251-943-3151
The Bar!

Enjoy our amazing cocktails, captivating live music, pool, darts, and more! We have a warm unique atmosphere for everyone! Must be at least 21 years of age to enter.

203 N Cypress St
Foley, AL 36535

Best drink selection in Foley!

Enjoy our tap selection, and don't forget to try out our special drinks,
Martinis of various sorts
Old fashioned cocktails
Imports and domestic Beers
Absinthe
Unique shots you can't get anywhere else in the area that are designed by our bartenders!

Bottled Beer

Sure we cover the basics, also with an array of new and interesting beers on hand to please your taste buds!

Liquors

We keep about 70 different liquors on hand so that everyone can have what they most enjoy.

SHOTS

We have a wide variety of shots in store, and if there is one you'd like to try or add we will be happy to craft it for you.

Testimony

“ Great new management and very classy new look. ”

— Matt R.

“ Great new beers and multiple on tap. Love it. ”

— Kevin N.

“ Great place to hang out and have a beer. ”

— Chris C.

“ This place rocks! ”

— Gigi A.

Owned and operated:

A lot of help came from others who believed in this building's potential as much as we did.

Fancy as f*ck

A classy little spot in Foley, designed to give real folks a rich experience without breaking the bank! We can also make you feel like a kid again

Max and Lori

In January 2014, 4 of us got together and made a decision to completely transform a building that was run down and tarnished by unsavory rumors. Wanting to create an atmosphere full of great experiences, and raise the expectations of what folks think a bar should be in Foley.

Ernie

Truly Original.

Doc Holiday's
HOME OUR STORY BEER / DRINKS EVENTS SPECIALS GALLERY TESTIMONIALS CONTACT ADMIN
Learn more about our history
Learn about the history, vision, and hard work that went into creating an entertaining, relaxing, and friendly atmosphere for you and your friends to enjoy!
Our Goal

In January 2014, a couple of us got together and made a decision to completely transform a building that was run down and tarnished by an unsavory history.. We wanted to create an atmosphere full of great experiences, and raise the expectations of what it means to be a bar in Foley.

OUR HISTORY
The Founders Meet

In January 2014, a couple of us got together and made a decision to completely transform a building that was run down and tarnished by unsavory rumors.

Save the bar and rebuild everything else

We wanted to create an atmosphere full of great experiences, and raise the expectations of what folks think a bar should be in Foley and with hard work and friends, we did just that.



NOW OPEN
1st year

We made it ! Now onward to bigger and better things!!

2nd year

Slowly things kept getting better. In the mean time we all worked on improving our cocktails, and building relationships with folks that have become family.

3rd year

Finally, word started to get around that the "stain" of Foley had been lifted! And folks really started coming in large groups, all of which enjoyed it.

Waiting on you

The years go by and we are supported by great customers, friends, and family. We are open 9Am to 2Am. Now we are just waiting on you to join us.

Our many thanks to you

A lot of help came from others who believed in this building's potential as much as we did.
They came in to show their support for our endeavor. These people kept our faith and determination going when things got tough.
While transforming this space was a lot of grueling work, it was well worth the effort and sweat.
We are extremely thankful for the perseverance and positive change they have inspired in us.

pages.text:
Doc Holiday's
HOME OUR STORY BEER / DRINKS EVENTS SPECIALS GALLERY TESTIMONIALS CONTACT ADMIN
Beer, liquors, snacks, and more!
Sit at our bar and let our friendly bartenders serve you a nice cocktail. From a quality selection of tap and bottled beers to special drinks and snacks, we work hard to keep our guests satisfied.
Unwind with a drink from our bar

Have a fun experience at our comfortable bar. Let our friendly bartenders provide you with a wonderful drink that you can truly enjoy.

Absinthe

Yes we love the "Green Fairy." We proudly serve Mata-Hari as our personal Absinthe of choice.

Bacardi

Bacardi Superior Rum is the original Bacardi rum, dating back to 1862 when Don Facundo Bacardi Massó purchased his first rum distillery in Cuba. 150 years later, Bacardi Superior is now manufactured in Puerto Rico, but the recipe remains largely the same.

Bombay Sapphire East

Additional hand picked botanicals make Bombay Sapphire East a truly stand out gin, ideal with tonic and equally perfect in a cocktail.

Bottled Beer

Sure we cover the basics, also with an array of new and interesting beers on hand to please your taste buds!

Bud Light

On tap or from ice cold bottle.. Always a house favorite!

Bumbu Rum: The craft rum

All-natural Bumbu Rum is based on the original recipe created by 16th and 17th century sailors of the West Indies, who blended native Caribbean ingredients into their rum and called it “Bumbu” – truly the original craft spirit.

Captain Morgan Private Stock

Captain Morgan Private Stock is one the most sophisticated rums to come from this long-standing tradition.

Elijah Craig

Crafted with care from extra-aged, hand-selected barrels.

Honey-Brown-Lager

This isn’t your watered-down light beer from college. Nor is it a heavy craft beer. Honey Brown pours right smack dab in the middle. A delicious golden amber color,

Jack Daniels

Jack Daniel's is a brand of Tennessee whiskey and the top-selling American whiskey in the world.

Jägermeister

Jim Beam

It is one of the best-selling whiskeys in the world and an iconic label.

Kettle One

Ketel One is a vodka appreciated by many. Using carefully selected European wheat and a combination of modern and traditional distilling techniques, they produced an exceptional product, both crisp to taste and soft on finish.

KRAKEN

Kraken Black Spiced Rum is a Caribbean black spiced rum. Unleash your Kraken!

Liquors

We keep about 70 different liquors on hand so that everyone can have what they most enjoy.

Martini Mondays

Martinis of various sorts

Mount Gay

Mount Gay Rum is produced by Mount Gay Distilleries Ltd. of Barbados, the easternmost island of the West Indies. The oldest surviving deed for the company is from 1703, making Mount Gay Rum the world’s oldest commercial rum distillery.

Rainbow

Believe it or not, the rainbow shot (or drink) isn't made with snake oil and unicorn tears. It's a vodka drink!

Russel's Reserve

Russell's Reserve 10 Year Old Bourbon is matured for over a decade in heavily charred casks under the scorching Kentucky sun.

SHOTS

We have a wide variety of shots in store, and if there is one you'd like to try or add we will be happy to craft it for you.

St-Germain

the liqueur created in the artisanal French manner from freshly hand-picked elderflower blossoms

Titos Handmade Vodka

Tito's Handmade Vodka is America's Original Craft Vodka produced in Austin, Texas. We make it in batches, use old-fashioned pot stills, and taste-test every batch.

UFO White

Light, crisp, refreshing and brewed with orange peel and coriander, UFO White follows in the tradition of spiced white beers that have been brewed in Belgium for well over 100 years. Cool down at a beachside bonanza with this brew. Serve with a slice of orange and enjoy!

Wild Turkey American Honey

an exceptionally smooth liqueur blended with pure American honey and real Wild Turkey Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey, perfect served chilled straight from the freezer or over rocks, it is the sweeter, smoother side of Wild Turkey.

A Damn Bag of popcorn

A whole damn bag of buttery flavor

Bacon Cheddar Bites

includes ranch or marinara

Bag of Chips

Assorted flavors

Chicken Quesadilla

includes source cream and salsa

Chicken Tender Bites

includes one sauce

Corn Dog

A corn dog is a hot dog on a stick that has been coated in a thick layer of cornmeal batter and deep fried.

Egg Rolls

2 large pork and veggie rolls with soy sauce

French Fries

with Cheese or Taco meet for an extra charge

French Toast Bites

So good you don't need syrup

Jack Links

Just like you like it..

Mozzarella Sticks

5 per order includes once sauce

Nachos Easy Cheesy

Single serve order of chips and cheese

Papa Murphy's Pizza

Pepperoni or 3 meat pizza

Spinach and Artichoke Dip

Served with NAAN Bread

Taquitos

4. per order includes sour cream and salsa

The Chos

Large order of chips, cheese, sour cream, salsa , taco meat and jalapeños

Wings

Seasoned or Buffalo includes ranch
